## Introduction

This project explores housing data from Melbourne, Australia.
The goal is to understand how property characteristics such as
type, number of rooms, and location relate to housing prices.

## Load Packages and Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

housing <- read_csv("Melbourne_housing_FULL.csv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Initial Data Exploration

```{r}
dim(housing)
names(housing)
head(housing)
```

## Check Missing Values

```{r}
colSums(is.na(housing))
```
